VG035.message: Delivery type not defined for order type
VG035.cause: The delivery type in the sales order is not properly configured for the selected order type in SPRO.
VG035.resolution:
1. Go to SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Shipping > Deliveries > Define Delivery Types
2. Check that the delivery type is assigned to the order type
3. Verify the item category determination in VOV4

M7021.cause: The posting date field is empty in the goods movement transaction (MIGO).
M7021.resolution:
1. Enter a valid posting date in the header area
2. Ensure the posting date falls within an open fiscal period
3. Check FM period lock via transaction OB52

F5003.message: Account not found in chart of accounts
F5003.cause: The GL account number entered does not exist in the assigned chart of accounts.
F5003.resolution:
1. Verify the GL account number via FS00
2. Check the correct chart of accounts is assigned to the company code
3. Create the account if it doesn't exist using FS00 or via mass upload

VK011.cause: A pricing condition record with the same key combination already exists in the condition table.
VK011.resolution:
1. Go to VK12 to display existing condition records
2. Check the validity dates — they may overlap
3. Either modify the existing record or change the validity period of the new one

ME045.message: Authorization check failed for purchase order
ME045.cause: The user does not have the required authorization object (M_BEST_BSA or M_BEST_EKG) for the purchase order type or purchasing group.
ME045.resolution:
1. Check user authorizations via SU53 immediately after the error
2. Request the BASIS team to add the missing authorization object
3. Verify the purchasing group assignment in the user master (SU01)

KI235.message: Cost center does not exist for the period
KI235.cause: The cost center is either not created or not valid for the posting period.
KI235.resolution:
1. Check cost center master data in KS03
2. Verify the validity dates of the cost center
3. Extend the validity period if necessary using KS02

BM001.message: Material does not exist or is not active
BM001.cause: The material number entered is not found in the material master or is flagged for deletion.
BM001.resolution:
1. Check material master in MM03
2. Verify the material exists in the correct plant
3. Check if the material is flagged for deletion (deletion flag in MM02)

V1321.message: Pricing error: Condition record not found
V1321.cause: The pricing procedure could not find a valid condition record for the material/customer combination.
V1321.resolution:
1. Check pricing conditions in VK13
2. Verify the condition type is included in the pricing procedure
3. Check customer/material info records and condition exclusion groups

VL244.cause: The system could not automatically determine a batch for the delivery item. Batch determination rules are missing, no stock exists for available batches, or the batch search strategy is not configured for the plant/delivery type combination.
VL244.resolution:
1. Check batch stock in MB52 for the material/plant
2. Verify batch determination config in SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Picking
3. Check condition records in VCH1 for the batch search strategy
4. Manual workaround: enter batch directly in VL02N at item level
5. If config missing, escalate for transport

ME390.message: Release strategy could not be determined
ME390.cause: No release strategy matches the purchase order's characteristics (purchasing org, plant, material group, PO value). Either the release strategy conditions don't cover this combination, or classification is misconfigured.
ME390.resolution:
1. Check release strategy customizing in SPRO > MM > Purchasing > PO > Release Procedure
2. Verify classification conditions in CL02 (class type 032)
3. Ensure characteristics match the PO values
4. Check release codes and groups in OME1/OME2
5. Emergency release via ME28 if business-critical

ME038.cause: The purchase order requires additional release codes before it can be processed. One or more approvers have not yet released the PO.
ME038.resolution:
1. Check pending release codes in ME23N > Release Strategy tab
2. Verify approver has auth object M_EINK_FRG
3. Check approver's workflow inbox (SBWP)
4. Use SWIA for work item analysis

F5091.message: Posting only possible in periods XXXX
F5091.cause: The posting date falls in a fiscal period that is not open for the account type being posted.
F5091.resolution:
1. Check open periods in OB52
2. Open the required period for the relevant account type
3. For MM postings, also check MMPV
4. Verify user has authorization for special periods (F_BKPF_BUP)

SU_USER_LOCKED.cause: User account is locked due to too many failed login attempts or administrator lock.
SU_USER_LOCKED.resolution:
1. Verify caller identity per security protocol
2. Check lock status in SU01
3. Unlock via SU01 Lock/Unlock button
4. Reset password if expired
5. Check SM20 audit log for failed login attempts

VA01.name: Create Sales Order
VA01.description: Create a new sales order. Enter order type, sales org, distribution channel, and division in the initial screen.

VA02.name: Change Sales Order
VA02.description: Modify an existing sales order. Enter the order number to make changes.

VA03.name: Display Sales Order
VA03.description: View a sales order in display mode (read-only).

ME21N.name: Create Purchase Order
ME21N.description: Create a new purchase order with the enjoy transaction. Supports direct PO creation and conversion from purchase requisitions.

ME23N.name: Display Purchase Order
ME23N.description: View a purchase order in display mode.

MIGO.name: Goods Movement
MIGO.description: Post goods movements including goods receipt, goods issue, transfer posting, and stock transfer.

MIRO.name: Invoice Verification
MIRO.description: Enter and verify vendor invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts.

FB60.name: Enter Vendor Invoice
FB60.description: Post vendor invoices directly in Financial Accounting (without MM integration).

FB01.name: Post Document
FB01.description: Create general FI posting documents including journal entries.

MM01.name: Create Material Master
MM01.description: Create a new material master record with all organizational views (basic data, purchasing, MRP, accounting, etc.).

XK01.name: Create Vendor Master (Centrally)
XK01.description: Create a vendor master record with both general data and company code data.

SU01.name: User Maintenance
SU01.description: Create, change, and display user master records. Assign roles, profiles, and set passwords.

SM37.name: Job Overview
SM37.description: Monitor and manage background jobs. View job status, logs, and scheduling details.

VL01N.name: Create Outbound Delivery
VL01N.description: Create an outbound delivery with reference to a sales order.

VF01.name: Create Billing Document
VF01.description: Create billing documents (invoices) with reference to deliveries or sales orders.

CO01.name: Create Production Order
CO01.description: Create a production order manually. Enter material, plant, and order type.

SE38.name: ABAP Editor
SE38.description: Create, modify, and execute ABAP programs and reports.

SPRO.name: Customizing
SPRO.description: SAP Implementation Guide (IMG). Entry point for all configuration and customization activities.

VL02N.name: Change Outbound Delivery
VL02N.description: Change an existing outbound delivery. Used for picking confirmation, packing, and Post Goods Issue (PGI). Enter delivery number to modify.

VL03N.name: Display Outbound Delivery
VL03N.description: Display an outbound delivery in read-only mode. Check delivery status, PGI status, and item details.

VL06G.name: List of Outbound Deliveries for Goods Issue
VL06G.description: Display list of deliveries ready for goods issue. Filter by shipping point, delivery date, and status. Used for mass PGI processing.

MB52.name: List of Warehouse Stocks on Hand
MB52.description: Display stock overview per material, plant, and storage location. Shows unrestricted, quality inspection, and blocked stock including batch details.

MB51.name: Material Document List
MB51.description: Display material document list filtered by material, plant, movement type, posting date. Essential for tracking goods movements history.

ME28.name: Release Purchase Order
ME28.description: Release (approve) purchase orders. Select POs by release group, release code, purchasing group, or PO number. Supports collective and individual release.

SU53.name: Authorization Check Display
SU53.description: Display the last failed authorization check for a user. Must be run IMMEDIATELY after the authorization error occurs. Shows the missing authorization object, field, and required values.

SM12.name: Display and Delete Locks
SM12.description: Display all enqueue lock entries in the system. Used to find and delete stale locks that block other users from processing documents.

SM20.name: Security Audit Log
SM20.description: Analyze the security audit log. Shows login attempts, transaction starts, RFC calls, and other security-relevant events.

WE02.name: Display IDOC
WE02.description: Display individual IDOC with full details including control record, data records, and status records. Filter by IDOC number, message type, partner.

WE05.name: IDOC Lists
WE05.description: Display IDOC overview list with filtering by date, status, direction, message type. Quick view of IDOC processing status across the system.

BD87.name: Reprocess IDOCs
BD87.description: Manually reprocess failed IDOCs (status 51, 56, 61, etc.). Select by IDOC number or date range and resubmit for processing.

OB52.name: Open/Close Posting Periods
OB52.description: Maintain posting period variants. Open and close fiscal periods for different account types (Assets, Customers, Vendors, GL, Materials).

MMPV.name: Close Period for Material Management
MMPV.description: Open or close posting periods specifically for Materials Management. MM periods are separate from FI posting periods.

VCH1.name: Create Batch Search Strategy (Condition Records)
VCH1.description: Maintain condition records for batch determination search strategy. Defines which batches to select based on classification characteristics.

MMRV.name: Allow Posting to Previous Period
MMRV.description: Toggle whether postings are allowed to the previous MM period. Used during month-end close to allow late postings.

PFCG.name: Role Maintenance
PFCG.description: Create, change, and maintain authorization roles. Define menu structure and generate authorization profiles for user access control.
